newsitem.title: GERMANY: Audi looking into building U.S. plant - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Audi looking into building U.S. plant - WSJ.

text.p: Audi AG, the luxury car unit of Volkswagen AG, is studying the feasibility of building a large production plant in the U.S. after the year 2000, the Wall Street Journal Europe reported on Thursday.
The newspaper said Audi had narrowed its search to five states in the southeastern part of the U.S. but that a final decision was some time off.
The five states under consideration are Alabama, Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina and Virgina.
The report said Audi was also considering building the plant in several other countries.
The Audi investment would mark the return to the U.S. for Volkswagen which produced cars in Pennsylvania for 10 years until 1988.
